messages.author: 303333961eebf6f4
messages.subject: Deploying a Sparklyr App
parts:
Hi,

What's the best way of deploying a sparklyr app to shinyapps.io? 

I attempted to just publish from Rstudio and not surprisingly, got the

ERROR: Spark version not installed. To install, use spark_install()

It wouldn't make sense to spark_install and build the massive spark jar on every new connection, is there a smarter way?

Jacky

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Deploying a Sparklyr App
parts:
Unfortunately, there is no ability to connect to a remote spark cluster from shinyapps.io today, due mostly to the fact that the performance of the integration requires that the R Process be next to the Spark cluster.

However, I know that the team working on sparklyr is looking at a solution that would enable an R process to work against a remote cluster. Once that is available, you should be able to use shinyapps.io to connect to your Spark cluster.
